stories.title: Why is November 26 celebrated as Constitution Day in India
stories.summary: Constitution Day, also known as Samvidhan Diwas, is observed every year on November 26 to commemorate the adoption of the Constitution of India in 1949 by the Constituent Assembly. However, November 26 is celebrated as the Constitution Day to commemorate the moment the Constitution of India was formally adopted for “We, the People of India”.
